items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: Javon was interviewed at Hamilton College on September 23, 2010 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Javon was interviewed at Hamilton College on September 23, 2010 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have saxophonist and composer Javon Jackson with me today, for the Jazz Archive.
